headline: L&T Finance provides business update for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27
hook: L&T Finance releases Q2 FY27 business update
summary: L&T Finance Limited has submitted its official business update for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27 to the stock exchanges. The filing provides preliminary operational metrics and portfolio trends for the quarter. Retail investors tracking the non-banking financial company sector can assess loan book growth and asset quality trends from the update. These quarterly disclosures help market participants gauge the lender's performance ahead of its detailed financial results.
why_it_matters: Early gauge of loan growth and asset quality for L&T Finance.
